usdRate.sourceName: RBI home page, FBIL reference rate INR per USD
usdRate.note: As at 1 pm, 30 October 2026. 2025 average 87.16 (World Bank).

inflation_cpi.sourceName: MoSPI All-India CPI (base 2024), provisional, via DD News
inflation_cpi.note: September 2026 year-on-year, provisional (August final 4.83%). MoSPI PDF could not be opened (certificate error), so read via the public broadcaster's report.

inflation_projection.sourceName: RBI target 4% (2-6% band); 5-year CPI average; RBI FY27 projection 5.2%
inflation_projection.note: CPI averaged about 5% over 2021-2025 and the RBI projects 5.2% for FY27, so we plan with 5% rather than the 4% target.

policy_rate.sourceName: Reserve Bank of India, current policy repo rate
policy_rate.note: Raised 25 bp from 5.25% at the MPC meeting of 5-7 October 2026.

savings_account_rate.sourceName: Reserve Bank of India home page, savings deposit rate (major banks)

fdr_3m_rate.sourceName: Largest public-sector bank card rate, 46-179 days, via Upstox
fdr_3m_rate.note: General public, deposits below Rs 3 crore. Private banks pay up to about 0.5 point more.

fdr_1y_rate.sourceName: Largest public-sector bank card rate, 1 to under 2 years, via Upstox
fdr_1y_rate.note: RBI home page shows 6.00%-6.75% for term deposits over 1 year at major banks; the Post Office 1-year time deposit pays 6.9%.

dps_rate.sourceName: Largest public-sector bank recurring deposit (5-10 year term rate), via Upstox
dps_rate.note: Bank recurring deposits earn the term-deposit rate for the tenure. The Post Office 5-year recurring deposit pays 6.7% (Oct-Dec 2026).

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: RBI, weighted average domestic term deposit rate on outstanding deposits of SCBs

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.sourceName: Ministry of Finance small savings rates for Oct-Dec 2026 (National Savings Certificate), via Business Today
sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: NSC, 5 years, compounded annually, paid at maturity. Senior Citizens' Savings Scheme pays 8.2%, PPF 7.1%.

tbill_91d_rate.sourceName: Reserve Bank of India, 91-day T-bill cut-off at the last auction

tbond_5y_rate.sourceName: Reserve Bank of India, 6.36% GS 2031 yield

tbond_10y_rate.sourceName: Reserve Bank of India, 6.94% GS 2036 yield

tax_bank_interest.sourceName: TDS on bank interest, Income-tax Act 2025 s.393(1) (was s.194A), via TaxGarden
tax_bank_interest.note: 10% withheld (20% without PAN) when interest from one bank exceeds Rs 50,000 a year (Rs 1 lakh for 60+). Interest is finally taxed at the slab rate (0-30%).

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: No flat or withholding rate: NSC interest is added to income and taxed at the individual's slab rate (0-30%), with no TDS; under the old regime yearly interest is deemed reinvested and counts for the 80C deduction. Searched Morningstar India, tax guides.

deposit_insurance_limit.sourceName: DICGC cover per depositor per bank, as stated in a bank explainer (Aug 2026)
deposit_insurance_limit.note: Rs 5 lakh including interest, unchanged since 4 Feb 2020. dicgc.org.in refused the connection; raising the limit has been discussed but no change found.

credit_card_rate_cap.note: No legal cap (the Supreme Court set aside a 30% consumer-forum cap in 2024). Major banks charge about 3.2%-3.6% a month, 38%-42% a year, plus GST.

equity_return_low.sourceName: Nifty 50 TRI trailing returns (1-year -0.4%, 3-year about 9.5%); after-tax safe rate
equity_return_low.note: Recent years were weak, so the low case is about the after-tax safe rate.

equity_return_base.sourceName: Nifty 50 TRI 10-year CAGR about 12% (Aug 2026); after-tax NSC/10-year G-sec about 6.7-6.9%
equity_return_base.note: The index earned about 12% a year over 10 years, but we cap the base at the after-tax safe rate plus about 3 points.

equity_return_high.note: A repeat of the long-run index record plus a little.

gold_return_low.sourceName: Rupee gold 10-year CAGR about 13-15%; INR per USD (FBIL)
gold_return_low.note: Gold can lose value in rupees for years after a bull run like 2016-2026.

gold_return_base.sourceName: Dollar gold long-run trend about 4-5% plus rupee depreciation about 3% a year
gold_return_base.note: Rupee gold returned about 13-15% a year over 2016-2026 in an exceptional rally; long-run we expect dollar gold plus rupee depreciation.

gold_return_high.note: Close to the last decade's record.

fixed_income_return_low.note: Bank deposits after tax at 10% give about 5.6%; lower if taxed at higher slabs.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: Post Office 1-year TD 6.9%, NSC 7.7%, 364-day T-bill 6.69%, less tax
fixed_income_return_base.note: A mix of bank deposits, government bills and small savings after tax at about 10%.

fixed_income_return_high.sourceName: Senior Citizens' Savings Scheme 8.2%, NSC 7.7%, less tax
fixed_income_return_high.note: Best government savings schemes after tax at about 10%.

life_claim_settlement_rate.sourceName: IRDAI Handbook on Indian Insurance Statistics 2024-25, individual death claims by number, via Insurance Business Asia
life_claim_settlement_rate.note: By amount 97.18%. IRDAI site not read directly.

insurance_term_premium_table.sourceName: Online term-plan premium guides for Rs 1 crore cover (StockCalc FY2026-27; Ditto Oct 2026)
insurance_term_premium_table.note: Rs 1 crore cover, 30-year term, non-smoker: about Rs 7,800-14,600 at 30, 15,000-25,300 at 40, 32,800 at 46-50, 48,300 at 51-55, 71,300 at 56-60 (per 1,000: divide by 10,000). Upper ends of the 50 and 65 bands extrapolated from the 56-60 quote; smokers pay about 1.7x. Insurers' names omitted.

health_hospitalisation_cost.sourceName: NSS 80th round (2025) health survey, average out-of-pocket spend per hospitalisation in private hospitals, via Counterview
health_hospitalisation_cost.note: Excludes childbirth. All hospitals Rs 34,064, public Rs 6,631 (Business Today). A surgical stay in a private hospital usually costs more.

health_premium_table.sourceName: Indicative individual health-insurance premiums for Rs 10 lakh cover (insurer and broker guides, 2026)
health_premium_table.note: Rs 10 lakh cover: about Rs 8,000 at 25 and Rs 10,850 at 30; Rs 18,300-22,000 at 45; Rs 15,000-35,000 at 45-60; senior plans about Rs 18,500-25,000 at 65 and Rs 30,000+ for many 60+ buyers. Before GST; varies by city and health.

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: MoSPI CPI health 1.40% (Sep 2026, new base); headline CPI plan 5%
goal_inflation_health.note: The new-series health CPI is unusually low; hospital and insurance costs have long risen faster than headline prices, so we plan with 3 points above general inflation.

goal_inflation_education.note: Private school and college fees rise faster than the education CPI, so we plan with 2 points above general inflation.

life_expectancy.note: Men 70.7, women 73.9. India's own SRS 2020-24 life table gives 70.6 (pulled down by the 2020-21 pandemic years).

life_table_remaining.sourceName: Registrar General of India, SRS Abridged Life Tables 2020-24 (published May 2026)
life_table_remaining.note: Expectation of life at the start of each age interval, total, India, 2020-24 (mid-period date).

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL (2025: 10.8) and UN WPP 2024 medium variant via PopulationPyramid.net (2040: 16.3, 2065: 33.4)
support_ratio.note: Working-age people per person 65+ = 100 / old-age dependency ratio.

retirement_age_default.sourceName: EPFO Employees' Pension Scheme 1995: superannuation pension age, via Kanakkupillai
retirement_age_default.note: Same for men and women; needs 10 years of service; early pension from 50 at 4% less per year. Many private employers retire staff at 58-60.

retirement_age_government.sourceName: Central government FR 56(a); Lok Sabha reply, via Gconnect
retirement_age_government.note: Central government employees retire at 60; some states and cadres differ (e.g. some teachers and doctors 62-65).

retirement_return_low.note: Plain bank deposits after 10% tax, or higher slab tax.

retirement_return_base.sourceName: Post Office 1-year TD 6.9% and 364-day T-bill 6.69%, less 10% tax
retirement_return_base.note: Equal to the after-tax 1-year government deposit and bill rate.

retirement_return_high.sourceName: Senior Citizens' Savings Scheme 8.2% less tax
retirement_return_high.note: Retirees who fill the SCSS limit earn about 7.4% after 10% tax.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: After-tax safe rate; Nifty 50 TRI weak recent years
retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: A balanced mix earning little more than safe deposits.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: Mix of equity base 10% and fixed income base 6%
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Roughly half equity and half safe fixed income over a working life.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: A growth-tilted mix in a good decade.

old_age_allowance_monthly.sourceName: PIB backgrounder on NSAP: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme central assistance
old_age_allowance_monthly.note: Central share Rs 200 a month at 60-79 and Rs 500 at 80+, for people in BPL families. States add Rs 50-5,700; PIB says the average pension is around Rs 1,100 in many states.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: Age 60+ in below-poverty-line families; central amount rises to Rs 500 at 80 (not 90).

gratuity_rule.sourceName: Code on Social Security 2020 s.53 (in force 21 Nov 2025), via Taxmann
gratuity_rule.note: 15 days' wages per completed year, monthly wage / 26; after 5 years' continuous service (1 year for fixed-term employees, waived on death or disability); capped at a ceiling notified by the government.

public_pension_scheme.sourceName: Atal Pension Yojana (PFRDA) contribution chart, via Indian Pay Calculator
public_pension_scheme.note: Guaranteed fixed pension Rs 1,000-5,000 a month from 60, then to the spouse for life; the corpus (Rs 1.7-8.5 lakh) goes to the nominee after both die. Not open to income-tax payers since Oct 2022. Contributions deductible under the old regime; pension is taxable. Formal-sector workers are in EPF/EPS instead.

fdr_3m.note: Banks and the Post Office offer terms from 7 days.

fdr_1y.note: Post Office Time Deposit (1-5 years) is the government equivalent.

dps.note: Banks and the Post Office (5-year RD, 6.7%).

sanchayapatra_5y.note: 5-year government certificate sold at post offices; also Kisan Vikas Patra, PPF and the Senior Citizens' Savings Scheme.

tbill_91d.note: Individuals can bid through the RBI Retail Direct portal.

tbond_5y.note: Through RBI Retail Direct or a broker.

tbond_10y.note: Through RBI Retail Direct or a broker.

equity_fund.note: SEBI-regulated; Nifty 50 index funds are widely available.

gold.note: Physical gold is legal and widely bought; BIS hallmarking applies. New Sovereign Gold Bond issues have stopped.

insuranceRegulator.name: Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI)

insuranceComplaints.name: Council for Insurance Ombudsmen
insuranceComplaints.note: Complain to the insurer first; IRDAI's Bima Bharosa portal also takes complaints.

pensionScheme.name: Atal Pension Yojana (PFRDA)
pensionScheme.note: Formal-sector workers are covered by EPFO (https://www.epfindia.gov.in/); NPS is open to all.

publicHealthCover.name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
publicHealthCover.note: Rs 5 lakh a year per family for eligible poorer households and for everyone aged 70+.

depositInsurance.name: Deposit Insurance and Credit Guarantee Corporation (DICGC)

statistics.name: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI)
